A has softer, cleaner shading on the body and grass; B's face wrinkles and grass tufts read slightly more texture-heavy.
B adds busier skin folds and a fussy dangling tag, while A keeps the smoother, simpler finish of the real cards.
A has denser face wrinkles and an extra tag, while B is slightly smoother and simpler, closer to the real cards' soft finish.
B's ears and face carry more fine fold texture, while A's forms are smoother and rounder, like the real gloves and chair.
Both are near-identical mirrored versions with the same rendering and finish, and neither is meaningfully closer.
